"Mandalorians."
"What?|[[Gilad Pellaeon]], [[Gideon]] and the warlord|}} A '''warlord''' was a member of the [[Shadow Council (Imperial Remnants)|Shadow Council]]. The warlord showed a visible sign of agreement to [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]'s proposal of the Council electing one of their own as their new leader instead of awaiting the return of the missing [[Chiss]] [[Grand Admiral]] of the [[Imperial Navy]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], or 'Thrawn', chuckling darkly in answer while [[Unidentified Imperial warlord 1|another warlord]] verbal applauded Gideon's statement. The warlord also demonstrated concern when Gideon's explained that the security concern to [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|his remnant]] that he had reported was the [[Mandalorian|warrior-people]] of [[Mandalore]], which the warlord exclaimed in answer to. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The warlord first appeared in "[[Chapter 23: The Spies]]," the seventh episode of [[The Mandalorian Season Three|season three]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' which was released on [[April 12]], [[2023]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1598416900689743873|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-12-1|quote=The Mandalorian and Grogu return March 1 only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/ytQHE}} They were portrayed by [[Marco Khan]]. ==Appearances== *[[The Mandalorian – The Graphic Novel of Season 3|''The Mandalorian'' – The Graphic Novel of Season 3]] {{Hologram}} *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 23: The Spies}} {{1st}} {{Hologram}} ==Sources== *{{InsiderCite|224|Who's the Boss?}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი იმპერიელი მხედართმთავარი 3 }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial warlords]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Shadow Council members]]
